## DNPC
### 0.1.4 Change Log
> Create train integration is experimental.
#### Global
##### Added
* Added a rare Dochi spawn Easter egg with a special skin and short sound.
* Added beekeeper work for harvesting honeycomb and honey bottles into NPC storage or chests.
* Added fisher work with visible lines and bobbers, configurable waits, and chest delivery.
* Added experimental Create train journeys with configurable boarding, carriage walking, and alighting paths.
* Added optional day-cycle travel and work while NPC chunks are unloaded, disabled by default.
* Added APIs for addons to manage NPC boarding, journeys, and exits on Create trains.
* Added unloaded NPC locations, status, and pause controls to World NPC Management.
* Added nine interface languages to match DRM, with translated main menus and English fallback.
* Added random NPC names from 11 language lists, including Dochi and 도치, with per-NPC settings.
* Added inventory-based conditional Create crank and valve controls.
* Added preservation of music session data when optional playback integration is unavailable.
##### Fixed
* Fixed inaccessible per-NPC interaction animation mappings caused by conflicting scroll handlers.
* Fixed displaced humanoid NPC arms when FA Player replaces the player model.
* Fixed unfinished Create control records being discarded or replayed after device replacement.
* Fixed malformed Create work data being reset instead of preserved.
* Fixed new work claiming another NPC's unfinished Create machine batch.
##### Improved
* Improved GeckoLib pose and equipment isolation from player-model resource packs.
#### Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Added
* Added preservation of imported music actions while playback integration is unavailable.
##### Fixed
* Fixed upper logs being excluded from the configured lumber radius.
#### Fabric 26.3
##### Added
* Added recipe loading compatibility between Create Fly and Farmer's Delight.
#### NeoForge 26.3
##### Added
* Added recipe loading compatibility between Create: Adapted and Farmer's Delight.
##### Fixed
* Fixed Farmers Delight resource inventory and recipe access.
* Fixed Create stock inventory access through native resource container wrappers.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 26.3
##### Added
* Added Create package delivery and Stock Ticker ordering while NPC chunks are unloaded.
#### Forge 1.20.1 / Fabric & NeoForge 1.21.1
##### Added
* Added unloaded music progress and playback restoration for verified Immersive Melodies instruments.
##### Fixed
* Fixed NPC restoration failing with DRM model callbacks before actor admission.
* Fixed saved music cursors being lost during NPC unloading and normal server restarts.
* Fixed old music notes continuing after NPC removal and restoration.
* Fixed changed or removed songs replacing saved music sessions with a new performance.
